content.title: How to Watch your Houston Astros | Houston Astros
content.text: Looking to find how to watch your Houston Astros this season? Check out the information below and be sure to check out when the Astros are playing at our schedule page. Space City Home NetworkSpace City Home Network is the television home of your Houston Astros. Space City is available on cable, satellite, and OTT providers in the region. All telecasts are available in Texas, Louisiana, Arkansas, Oklahoma, and portions of New Mexico.Visit the links below to find Space City Home Network in your area:SCHN+SCHN+ is the newest way to watch the Astros anytime, anywhere! The SCHN+ app delivers all Space City Home Network programming including live coverage of the Houston Astros and Houston Rockets, behind the scenes features and on-demand content. And the best part? No cable, satellite subscription, or contract is required! Fans who already have Space City Home Network through a participating cable, satellite, or streaming provider can access the app for free by logging in with your provider TV credentials. MLB.TVFor Astros fans out-of-market:Stream out-of-market MLB games live or on demand on your favorite supported devices. Plus, enjoy MLB Big Inning and select Pregame and Postgame coverage. Blackout and other restrictions apply. Sign up for MLB.TV today.Apple TV Friday Night BaseballWatch Friday Night Baseball on Apple TV. Don't have an Apple TV subscription?
